launcher.notes: ANY NETWORK — fix for 'fail to download the forge universal jar': the two TLauncher-stack classpath jars are now ALSO committed to this repo (hosted/) and download through 5 independent mirrors (raw.githubusercontent → jsDelivr .pack alias → github.com/raw → release asset → official maven/TLauncher origin), every hop sha1-gated (dc0e4003… / d1f454ec…); corrupt jars auto-deleted and re-downloaded; bundled copy itself sha1-checked before use. Launch stack unchanged: byte-pure vanilla 1.8.9 client + official Forge 11.15.1.1764 universal + OptiFine HD U M5 (TLauncher's exact artifacts, token-exact args). Bundle: Kinetrix Client v3.3.8.

notes: Client 3.4.0 "Cosmetics Round": (1) animated capes now play a REAL live animated preview in the cosmetics menu (both the in-game KUI screen and the title-screen screen) - they were frozen on frame 0, (2) Cape tab gained All / Normal / Animated filter buttons so capes are categorized, plus an ANIMATED badge on animated cards, (3) real-time cosmetics sync on account switching - the profile-sync identity caches (resolved name / revision / skin) are dropped the moment the MC session changes, so the NEW account's website cosmetics apply immediately instead of the old account's sticking forever, (4) Hitbox: new Show My Hitbox toggle (default OFF) and the own hitbox can never render in first-person POV anymore (only third-person), (5) fixed: AutoGG Message / Secondary Message (all TextBox settings) now persist across client restarts (the config loader had no TextBox branch). Launcher/forge sections unchanged.
